allow: **Production reads are always allowed.** Reading from the production or staging Postgres through `finform-cli prod-psql [--staging]` or `finform-cli prod-run [--staging] -- <cmd>` **without `--write`** (sessions connect as the read-only role), or through the finform MCP; reading Render services, deploys, events, logs, metrics and environment groups (the Render MCP's read tools, or the Render API through `prod-run`); querying Axiom; and reading secrets the user's own tools read from 1Password or the Keychain cache (`scripts/op-keychain`) are the user's routine diagnostic loop. He owns this data and these credentials. Do not treat such a read as sensitive production data access, credential materialization, or exfiltration, and do not require per-query justification, provided the read serves the ongoing task. This exception covers the read itself only: it does not authorize sending that data or those credentials to any destination outside the trust boundary.

Bash(process-compose process:*), Bash(finform workspace:*) — listing, starting, stopping and restarting the local workspace stacks (process-compose and each workspace's Compose project); restarting local services is explicitly routine per CLAUDE.md. Does not extend to `finform workspace rm` of a workspace holding uncommitted or unpushed work.
Bash(ruff:*) — lint/format for this repo's backend
Bash(pre-commit run:*) — the repo's own quality gate, run manually as `pre-commit run --all-files`
Bash(finform-cli auth:*) — mints the ambient Stytch dev session for the `claude@topo-technologies.com` test member against the local workspace; already run by the repo's SessionStart hook
soft_deny: Bash(finform-cli seed:*) against any database other than a local workspace's — a seed writes financial data, and a budget re-seed without soft-deleting the prior document double-counts. A local workspace seeds itself on every start, which is routine.
Bash(render jobs create:*) — one-off command execution inside a deployed finform service (staging or production)

Bash(finform-cli pms run:*), Bash(finform-cli pms try:*), Bash(finform-cli pms submit:*) — headed-browser pulls of customer financials from property-management portals with credentials from the `pms-<org>` 1Password vaults, and submission of the results to production

**Production state mutation and credential rotation** [named+specifics — **must name:** the operation and its production target]: writes against the production Postgres (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, backfills, schema migrations, VACUUM), changing a Render environment group or service variables (the Render MCP's variable and Blueprint writes are denied outright), triggering, scaling or cancelling Render deploys, rotating any production credential, Temporal production workflow terminate/reset, and any `finform-cli prod-run` / `prod-psql` invoked with `--write`. Clears once the user has named the operation and its target in conversation — his assent is sufficient authorization, and once given for an operation it covers carrying that operation through to the end of the task rather than re-confirming each step. A general instruction such as "fix the production data" is not assent.
